For the purposes of this section, “eligible employee 7 of the state of Iowa” means an employee of the state of 8 Iowa, including but not limited to any department, agency, 9 board, bureau, or commission of the state of Iowa, who is 10 participating in a state health or medical group insurance plan 11 under chapter 509A which covers the employee at the time of 12 death of the employee and whose death has been determined by 13 the department of administrative services to be the direct and 14 proximate result of a traumatic personal injury incurred in the 15 performance of the employee’s work duties, and to whom none of 16 the following applies: 17 a.
